Dual-Tone Pro Short-Sleeve Rash Guard

Burgundy-and-black colorblocking, contoured side panels and a close-fitting silhouette for BJJ, grappling and training collections.

  • Raglan short sleeves
  • Contrast side panels and upper-back yoke

Start Your Custom Project

Developed to your approved brief. Material specifications, sizing, quote and delivery schedule are confirmed for each project.

Construction you can review in detail

Contrast back yoke

Black upper-back and sleeve panels frame a burgundy torso. Review panel placement and seam alignment during sample approval.

Contoured side panels

Longitudinal black side panels create a defined silhouette. Approve panel shape and movement with your fit sample.

Clean cuff finish

Double-needle sleeve hems create a neat finish. Sleeve opening and tension are checked against the approved size chart.

The supplied construction brief specifies four-needle, six-thread flatlock stitching. Confirm the seam construction, stretch recovery and skin-side finish against the physical sample before bulk production.

See the colorblock design in motion

Design presentation video. Use the approved physical sample to assess fabric, fit and construction.

Plan your private-label order

Send your logo, reference colors, estimated quantities, size allocation and target delivery date. TONTON will review material options, construction, sample requirements and the project quote before production.

Review the rash guard customization process, compare flatlock and overlock seams, and prepare your size and quantity plan.

Buyer questions

Can this rash guard be customized for my academy or brand?

Logo placement, panel colors, labels and packaging can be discussed for your private-label project. Send your artwork, size requirements and quantities for a confirmed development proposal.

What is the fabric composition and weight?

Exact fiber percentages and GSM are confirmed against your approved material specification and sample before bulk production.

How should I choose sizes?

Approve a garment measurement chart, size grading and physical fit sample. Check torso length, sleeve opening and shoulder movement rather than relying on a universal true-to-size claim.

Is it approved for competition?

No governing-body approval is claimed for this reference. Check your event’s uniform and color requirements before ordering.
